从叠加和音量两块元件起步，亲手搭出造波形的元件。: Starting from Mix and Volume, build parts that make waves yourself.
每块元件只做一件事，怎样造出更复杂的波形？: Each part does one thing: how do you make a richer wave?
一串按先后排好的数，每一格记下那一刻的高低。: Numbers in order, each sample how high the wave stands at that moment.
把两个一样长的波形逐格相加。: Adds two waves of the same length, sample by sample.
把波形的每一格乘以 k。: Multiplies every sample of the wave by k.
板左边是这一关给的一个数和两段<wiki-ref to=\"wave\"></w: The number and the two <wiki-ref to="wave"></wiki-ref> this level gives are on the left of the board, the wave to give on the right. The two parts at hand each do one thing: one makes a wave louder, the other lays two waves over each other.
给出 a 放大 k 倍、再叠上 b 的波形。: Gives a made k times as loud, with b mixed in.
把 a 放大 k 倍，再叠上 b。: Make a k times as loud, then mix in b.
一块元件的输出可以接到另一块元件的输入上。: One part’s output can go into another part’s input.
这一关给的波形多了一段。: This level gives one more wave.
交出 p 倍的 a、q 倍的 b 和 c 叠在一起的波形。: Give p times a, q times b and c, mixed together.
